Username: [NOTES] Username and Email must be UNIQUE. PasswordHash must be BCrypt hash - use Scripts/HashGenerator/ tool to generate. Example hash is for password TestPass123!. Status must be active inactive or locked. Roles is comma-separated list (Admin Analyst External Public). TwoFactorMethod options: Email SMS TOTP Both. PhoneNumber required if TwoFactorMethod includes SMS. User must have at least one role.
